text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty -> page fired: infra.embed.5xx.high (severity: P1)
incident-bot: Trigger: rollout/green-v2.11 staged deploy -> spike in 5xx to embed model (EU region). Auto-escalation to ops-oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PD alert: infra.embed.5xx.high -> page sent to Ops Oncall (Omar K).
Omar K: ack'd. I'm on it, pulling logs + checking canary slice.
Emily S: saw increased 5xx at 10:32 UTC in EU-1, p95 latency also up. Affected route: /v1/embeddings.
Sri P: noticed errors are upstream 502/503 from the quantized embed workers, not the proxy. Sending kernel logs to thread.
Omar K: running quick query: `sum(rate(requests{region="eu"} [1m]) * (status >= 500))` -> roughly 2.1% of total token requests in EU. Not huge but customer-facing.
Product Oncall: any paying customers impacted? We should notify CS if SSO customers seeing issues.
Emily S: one enterprise customer on EU LZ reported failed batch jobs, support ticket #CS-4432.
Omar K: I can reproduce locally against canary variant: tail of worker shows repeated `kv_cache_mismatch` after quant path selection. Hypothesis: new quant kernel in v2.11 behaving poorly on sequence lengths >8k.
Sri P: timeline: rollout started at 10:00 UTC -> 10:26 ramped to 20% traffic, errors climb at 10:30. Canary id: rollout-2026-03-14-17.
Omar K: mitigation options: 1) pause rollout (stop further ramp), 2) divert EU traffic to previous model variant, 3) rollback canary to v2.10. Which do we want?
Emily S: prefer divert to previous verified model for minimal churn. If pivot quick, can avoid global rollback.
Product Oncall: CS, flag customers and open incident advisory if >5% or important tenants affected. Right now looks isolated but tell CS to prep.
Omar K: executing traffic diversion: `redwoodctl traffic-split set --service=embed --region=eu --variant=stable-v2.10 --weight=100`
incident-bot: traffic-split change submitted -> ID ts-98765.
pagerduty-bot: PD note: Ops Oncall changed routing for eu embed -> stable-v2.10. Please monitor.
Emily S: after diversion, errors drop within 60s. Grafana shows EU 5xx down to baseline.
Sri P: confirming: worker crash count stopped; quant kernel backtrace gone.
Omar K: keeping canary paused and re-running a smaller validation set against v2.11 in staging to reproduce.
Product Oncall: decide on next steps: do we rollback or keep v2.11 paused and revert later?
Emily S: recommend rollback of canary to preserve safety and unblock release pipeline. We'll redeploy v2.11 only after kernel fix.
Omar K: initiating rollback of staged rollout: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --id=rollout-2026-03-14-17`
incident-bot: rollout cancel submitted -> rollback job id rb-20260314-17.
pagerduty-bot: PD note: rollback started.
Sri P: rolling back quant kernels on canary pool and restarting pods in EU. Estimated 8m for full drain.
Ops Oncall: switching to watch mode, will keep pinned observability dashboard up for 30m.
Emily S: drafting customer advisory: short explanation, impacted route, mitigation (traffic diverted, rollback), ETA for follow-up. Will send to CS and trust them to triage enterprise tickets.
Product Oncall: tagging stakeholders: @growth, @support, @security (no data leak).
Omar K: after rollback completed (now), EU 5xx at baseline and p95 latency back to normal. No further crashes.
Sri P: postmortem action items: 1) run quant kernel test with >8k seq lengths in CI, 2) add metric for quant kernel OOMs/crash, 3) add canary health check that runs a longer sequence validation.
Emily S: assigning actions: Sri -> CI tests, Omar -> canary health check, Emily -> customer advisory + CS debrief.
Omar K: handoff: I'm heading to a meeting, passing to Ops Oncall (night shift). Please pick up monitoring and reopen PD if regression returns.
Ops Oncall: ack, taking handoff. I'll keep a 2h watch window and escalate if any bump.
pagerduty-bot: PD: alert resolved. Note: manual mitigation performed (traffic diversion + rollback).
incident-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2026-0314-17 with summary: "Staged embed rollout caused EU 5xx spike; traffic diverted and rollout rolled back."
Product Oncall: ETA for postmortem draft? 48h please.
Emily S: will draft and circulate to infra and product in 24h, full postmortem in 48h.
Sri P: quick logs attached for postmortem: stack traces + metrics snapshot.
Omar K: thumbs up, closing thread unless anyone sees regression. :white_check_mark:
Ops Oncall: monitoring green for 25m, no new alerts. Closing PD.
